sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct download | SourceForge.net
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct is a 3.75 billion parameter multimodal model by Qwen, designed to handle complex vision-language tasks in both image and video formats. As part of the Qwen2.5 series, it supports image-text-to-text generation with capabilities like chart reading, object localization, and structured data extraction.
